<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_3DPrint" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/3dprint">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_3DPrint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Sketches" name="Sketches" sourceRef="Task_Send_Sketches" targetRef="Participant_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ChangeRequest" name="Change request" sourceRef="Task_Send_Change_Request" targetRef="Participant_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Draft" name="Project draft" sourceRef="Participant_Artist" targetRef="Task_Receive_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_STL" name="Final STL file" sourceRef="Participant_Artist" targetRef="Task_Receive_STL"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Instruct an artist to create a 3D model and print it" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Need" name="Custom 3D model needed"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Send_Sketches" name="Send sketches to artist (instruct artist to create project)"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Revision_Merge" name="Revision merge"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_Receive_Draft" name="Receive project draft from artist"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Review_Draft" name="Review project draft"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfied_Split" name="Satisfied with result?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Send_Change_Request" name="Tell artist what to change"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_Receive_STL" name="Receive final STL file from artist"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Choose_Color" name="Choose plastic color"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Stock_Split" name="Color in stock at home?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Check_Amount" name="Check remaining amount of plastic"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Amount_Split" name="Less than 100 g left?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Add_Shopping_List" name="Add plastic to shopping list"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Amount_Merge" name="Amount checked"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Order_Color" name="Order plastic color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Plastic_Merge" name="Plastic available"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prep_Split" name="Start preparation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Heat_Up" name="Turn on printer and heat up bed and extruder (monitor status continuously)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Generate_Gcode" name="Generate G-code file from STL"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prep_Join" name="Printer ready and G-code generated"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Print" name="Print model"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Printed" name="Model printed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_01" sourceRef="Start_Need" targetRef="Task_Send_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_02" sourceRef="Task_Send_Sketches" targetRef="Gateway_Revision_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_03" sourceRef="Gateway_Revision_Merge" targetRef="Task_Receive_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_04" sourceRef="Task_Receive_Draft" targetRef="Task_Review_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_05" sourceRef="Task_Review_Draft" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_06" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied_Split" targetRef="Task_Send_Change_Request"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_07" sourceRef="Task_Send_Change_Request" targetRef="Gateway_Revision_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_08" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied_Split" targetRef="Task_Receive_STL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_09" sourceRef="Task_Receive_STL" targetRef="Task_Choose_Color"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_10" sourceRef="Task_Choose_Color" targetRef="Gateway_Stock_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_11" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Stock_Split" targetRef="Task_Check_Amount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_12" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Stock_Split" targetRef="Task_Order_Color"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_13" sourceRef="Task_Check_Amount" targetRef="Gateway_Amount_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_14" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount_Split" targetRef="Task_Add_Shopping_List"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_15" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Amount_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_16" sourceRef="Task_Add_Shopping_List" targetRef="Gateway_Amount_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_17" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Plastic_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_18" sourceRef="Task_Order_Color" targetRef="Gateway_Plastic_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_19" sourceRef="Gateway_Plastic_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_20" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Split" targetRef="Task_Heat_Up"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_21" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Split" targetRef="Task_Generate_Gcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_22" sourceRef="Task_Heat_Up" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_23" sourceRef="Task_Generate_Gcode" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_24" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Join" targetRef="Task_Print"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_25" sourceRef="Task_Print" targetRef="End_Printed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
